heading: Skills
description: Instructions your team reuses, kept as pages: how to wrap up meeting notes, reply to a customer or triage a request. Pick one in the AI chat with /, or from an AI app connected to the workspace. Each skill is a page or database row; people see the skills they can open.

import.label: Import skills from SKILL.md, Markdown or ZIP files
import.skippedFiles: {count, plural, one {# file beside them was left out.} other {# files beside them were left out.}}

emptyHint: Any page or database row can be a skill too: open it and turn on Use as skill in its ⋯ menu.

builtins.heading: Start from a ready-made skill
builtins.hint: Each one becomes a row of your skills database: change it to fit your work, then share it with your team.

downloadHint: A ZIP with the skill's SKILL.md, for AI assistants that install skills

menu.hint: Offer this page as reusable instructions in the AI chat and to AI apps connected to the workspace
menu.databaseHint: Every row of this database is a skill; its Description property says what each one is for

bar.label: Skill

chat.heading: Skills
chat.pickHint: Use a skill (or type / in the empty box)
